overall_assessment: Section extraction for HiOF is very good: all seven canonical sections are split correctly at the headings, arbeidskrav are correctly filed under coursework_requirements, learning outcomes keep all three Kunnskap/Ferdigheter/Generell kompetanse groups, and admin blocks (Arbeidsomfang, Praksis, Sensorordning, Evaluering) are dropped. The pre-pass flags (boilerplate, leak->X, long) are false alarms; the only real issues are reading_list rows that just point to Leganto and minor placeholder/whitespace noise.

findings.evidence: Gjeldende litteraturliste for 2025 Høst finner du i Leganto
findings.description: For recent years (2022-2025) the reading_list row contains only a one-line pointer to the Leganto reading-list system (or 'Litteraturliste vil bli publisert i Leganto før semesterstart.'), not an actual reading list. The section is emitted as a row although it carries no bibliographic content. This is the faithful content of the plan, but it is a placeholder, and older years of the same courses have full lists, so analyses over time will see reading_list vanish.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: HiOF moved reading lists to Leganto; the source page only contains the pointer sentence, and .clean_sections() in R/extract_sections.R does not recognise it as a placeholder.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() (R/extract_sections.R), drop reading_list rows that match /Leganto/ and are shorter than ~150 chars (or set them to empty_placeholder and filter downstream), so the absence of a real list is explicit.

findings.description: The 'Absolutte forkunnskaper' and 'Anbefalte forkunnskaper' blocks are concatenated and the recommended-prerequisites placeholder 'Ingen' is kept as text inside an otherwise real prerequisites row.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Both 'Absolutte forkunnskaper' and 'Anbefalte forkunnskaper' headings map to prerequisites; placeholders are not stripped.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections(), remove lines that are exactly 'Ingen'/'Ingen.'/'-' from prerequisites text, and drop the row if nothing remains.

findings.evidence: KunnskapStudenten har kunnskap om  ulike sjanger- og stilideal
findings.description: In the music (MUS) courses the sub-headings are glued to the following text ('KunnskapStudenten', 'FerdigheterStudenten', 'Generell kompetanseStudenten'), whereas the plan has a space or newline. Content is complete and correctly placed; only whitespace is lost. Similar glue appears in assessment of hiof_LMUSAM10417-1_2019_spring_2 ('Individuell muntlig eksamenVarighet ca. 30 minutter'), which is already present in the source.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Text extraction (R/extract_fulltext.R / .add_table_cell_breaks) joins inline elements without a separator for these pages.
findings.suggested_fix: Insert a newline or space between an adjacent heading-like word (Kunnskap/Ferdigheter/Generell kompetanse) and 'Studenten'/'Kandidaten' in the extraction pre-processing.
